title: Pardesi musafir ki
body:
Pardesi musafir ki
Halminasir yansuruna x 4
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
(Kuch sehme huye bache) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Behta huwa pani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay karbobala tere, Daman mein chupa kya kya, (Bachpan ali asger ka) x2
akber ki jawaani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
taabut, alam, jula, pani ki sabile bhi, (jis simt nazar jaaye) x2
pyaaso ki nishani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
mansoob alam se jo, ek mashke sakina hai, (amu se bhatiji ki) x2
ulfat ki nishaani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
ansoo na ruke logo, shabbir ki majlis mein, (us ujre huye gar ki) x2
yu yaad manaani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ye kehte the, mein kaise ijazat du, (ay qasim tu mere) x2
bhayi ki nishaani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
ye laashaye akber par, layla ne kahan ro kar, (kyu khoon me tar teri) x2
poshak shahani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
de te the sadaa sarwar, abbas chale aawo, (mayat ali akber ki) x2
ab mujko uthani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
rota hai falak ab tak, shabbir tere gham mein, (dunya ye samaj ti hai) x2
barsaat ka paani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh bole bahan zainab, zindaa se riha ho kar, (rudaade sitam jaakar) x2
amma ka sunani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
ey mere khuda tujse, har waqt duwa ye hai, (maula ki safay matam) x2
har gar mein bichani hai
<<MINI>>
(Pardesi musafir ki purdard kahani hai) x2
(Kuch sehme huye bache) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Behta huwa pani hai
